name: Totals Report for WooCommerce
author: Christoforos Aivazidis

sections.description:
Totals Report for WooCommerce provides a powerful, easy-to-use interface for tracking and analyzing your WooCommerce product inventory. With a single click, store managers can access critical insights about their product catalog.

Key Features

  • Total product count
  • In-stock and out-of-stock product tracking
  • Low stock and backorder monitoring
  • Detailed variation analysis
  • Stock quantity overview
  • Category-specific inventory data
  • Performance optimized
  • Multisite compatible
  • Translation ready

Performance and Compatibility

  • WordPress 5.0+ compatible
  • WooCommerce 5.0.0+ support
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatible
  • PHP 7.2+ required

Use Cases

  • Quickly assess overall inventory health
  • Track product availability
  • Identify low stock items
  • Monitor backorder products
  • Understand product type distribution
  • Monitor category-specific product metrics

Additional Information

For more information, visit BigDrop.gr
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/totals-report-for-woocommerce directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Totals Report to view your product insights
sections.faq:
How does this plugin improve WooCommerce inventory management?

Totals Report for WooCommerce provides a comprehensive overview of your entire product catalog in one centralized dashboard. This allows you to quickly assess inventory status, identify out-of-stock products, and understand product distribution across categories and types without having to navigate through multiple WooCommerce screens.

Will this plugin slow down my WooCommerce store?

No, the plugin is designed with performance in mind. It uses efficient database queries and implements caching mechanisms to ensure minimal impact on your store’s performance, even with large product catalogs. The report data is generated only when needed and cached for future use.

Does the plugin work with variable products and product variations?

Yes, Totals Report for WooCommerce fully supports variable products and their variations. The report provides detailed information about total variations across your store and intelligently tracks stock status for variable products based on the availability of their variations.

Can I export the inventory reports?

Absolutely! The plugin offers multiple export formats including CSV, JSON, and XML. This makes it easy to share inventory data with team members or import it into external systems for further analysis.

Is the plugin compatible with custom product types?

Yes, the plugin works with all standard WooCommerce product types and provides a flexible framework that supports custom product types. It will track and categorize any product type registered in your WooCommerce store.

Does this plugin work with multilingual stores?

Yes, Totals Report for WooCommerce is fully translation-ready and supports internationalization. The plugin includes translation files and can be easily translated into any language using standard WordPress translation tools.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest versions of WordPress and WooCommerce?

Yes, we regularly test and update the plugin to ensure compatibility with the latest versions of both WordPress and WooCommerce. The plugin supports WordPress 5.0+ and WooCommerce 5.0.0+, including the new High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) system.

Does the plugin require any special server requirements?

Totals Report for WooCommerce has minimal server requirements beyond what WordPress and WooCommerce already need. It requires PHP 7.2 or higher and a properly configured WordPress installation with WooCommerce active.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Changed terminology from “Available” to “In Stock” to match WooCommerce standards
  • Added Low Stock and On Backorder tracking for products
  • Added pagination to the Category Reports for easier navigation with large catalogs
  • Added “rows per page” option to customize the number of categories displayed
  • Redesigned the report interface to be wider and left-aligned
  • Moved export buttons to the bottom of the page
  • Improved category report with new columns:
    • Low Stock Products – Shows the number of products with low stock levels in each category
    • On Backorder Products – Shows the number of backorder products in each category
  • Enhanced export functionality to include the new low stock and backorder data

1.0.1

  • Fixed display of category names in reports (previously showing slugs)
  • Added new columns to the Product Categories report:
    • Available Products – Shows the number of in-stock products for each category
    • Out of Stock Products – Shows the number of out-of-stock products for each category
    • Variable Products – Shows the number of variable products for each category
  • Improved export functionality to include the new category data
  • Fixed plugin code to meet WordPress.org guidelines
  • Added formal WooCommerce dependency declaration
  • Improved code organization and namespacing

1.0.0

  • Initial public release
  • Added comprehensive product reporting
  • Included export functionality (CSV, JSON, XML)
  • Added multilingual support
  • Implemented performance optimization with caching
